steps.en: Install the adapter for your framework
steps.zh: 安装对应框架的适配包

steps.en: Create a store from plain initial state, e.g. at module scope
steps.zh: 用普通初始值创建 store，可以放在模块顶层

steps.en: Wraps the value in a signal and tracks which derived stores read it
steps.zh: 把值包成信号，并记下哪些派生 store 读了它

steps.en: Read only the slice a component needs through a selector
steps.zh: 组件里用选择函数只读它需要的那一小块

steps.en: Update with an immutable updater from anywhere
steps.zh: 在任何地方用返回新对象的函数更新

steps.en: Recomputes derived stores and re-renders only components whose slice changed
steps.zh: 重算派生 store，只让选中那块变了的组件重渲染

value.en: One shared state object outside the component tree, with no context plumbing and no re-render of unrelated components
value.zh: 组件树外有一份共享状态，不用层层传 context，无关组件也不会跟着重渲染
